text: Setting clear goals is the foundation of any successful project. To ensure your objectives are effective, use the SMART framework: they should be Specific, Measurable, Achievable, Relevant, and Time-bound. Once your main goal is defined, break it down into smaller milestones. These are checkpoints that help you track progress and stay motivated. Each milestone should lead to a concrete deliverable, such as a report or a prototype, which proves that work is being completed. Finally, stakeholder alignment is crucial. Make sure everyone involved, from team members to clients, understands and agrees on the goals and the plan. This shared understanding prevents confusion and keeps the project moving smoothly toward a common vision.
